events.text: Judah taken to Babylon; some return and rebuild the temple.
The Maccabean revolt; a brief Jewish kingdom.
Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Herod's sons rule Galilee; a Roman governor rules Judea.
Jerusalem and the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Alexander the Great and the kingdoms that follow him.
Rome takes control (63 BC); Augustus becomes emperor.
Tiberius is emperor; Pilate governs Judea.
Rome rebuilds its grip after the Jewish war.
Jesus is born near the end of Herod's reign
Most of the story takes place

teaser.title: Herod the Great rules for Rome
teaser.text: Jesus is born near the end of Herod's reign, which ended around 4 BC. The exact year is debated.

teaser.title: Jesus' ministry
teaser.text: Usually placed around AD 28–33, in Galilee and then Jerusalem.

teaser.title: Matthew is written
teaser.text: Many scholars say AD 70–90; some argue for before 70. Debated.
